title: Qwen3 run manifest (v2)
description: Schema cho manifest Qwen3 trong manifests_qwen3/. Khac schema V1 o cho: (a) bat buoc co `regenerable` va `limitation` de noi ro thu gi khong kiem chung duoc, (b) `dataset_sha256` kem `dataset_sha256_scope` vi hash phu thuoc loai details, (c) `scorer_status` phai noi ro scorer co con tren dia hay khong.

run_id.description: sinh tu ten file + dataset_sha256; bat bien giup phat hien manifest bi sao chep.

model_path_kind.description: Cho biet 'model' la ten trong Ollama hay basename cua thu muc dia. Duong dan may-lab khong duoc commit; chi giu basename.

dataset_sha256.description: sha256 cua noi dung da cham thuc su. Pham vi chinh xac nam o dataset_sha256_scope.

dataset_sha256_scope.description: Bắt buộc: hash bao phu cai gi. Voi schema 'harness' chi khop tap cau, KHONG khop noi dung cau.

scorer.description: duong dan tuong doi trong repo nay, hoac null neu khong xac dinh duoc.

timestamp_source.description: timestamp lay tu mtime file manifest, KHONG phai gio chay that.

regenerable.description: Tat ca manifest Qwen3 deu can GPU. Hang nay ton tai de nguoi doc khong tuong lai nham tinh lai tu 0.
